name: aegis
description: Aegis — Gerenciador de senhas & autenticação 2FA (PWA + extensão Chrome)

scripts.build: (cd apps/pwa && tsc -b && vite build) && (cd apps/extension && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts)
scripts.build:extension: cd apps/extension && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts
